model_annotation: The bar chart displays the negative log probability for various per-specialty terms, including Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, across different models: Mistralv0.2-Base and models fine-tuned on Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The x-axis represents the per-specialty terms, while the y-axis shows the negative log probability, with values ranging from approximately -22 to -27. Each specialty term has a corresponding bar for each model, with the bars for the fine-tuned models generally being shorter (indicating higher probability) than the Mistralv0.2-Base model. The bars are color-coded, with the Mistralv0.2-Base model represented by a light blue bar and the fine-tuned models represented by various shades of orange and brown, corresponding to the specific specialty they were fine-tuned on. The chart shows that the fine-tuned models generally have lower negative log probabilities (higher probability) for the specialty they were fine-tuned on, with the most significant improvement seen in the Cardio specialty, where the fine-tuned Cardio model has a much lower negative log probability compared to the Mistralv0.2-Base model.
